title: Bound on a sum by a uniform bound
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list of natural numbers, let $f$ map natural numbers to natural numbers, and let $B$ be a natural number. If $f(a)\le B$ for every $a$ in $l$, then the sum of the values $f(a)$ over the list, counting repetitions, is at most the length of $l$ multiplied by $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a list of natural numbers
$f$ maps natural numbers to natural numbers
